title: Successive updates at one coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a sign vector on $n$ coordinates, and let $i$ be a coordinate. Replacing coordinate $i$ first by $a$ and then by $b$ has the same effect as replacing it directly by $b$, for any signs $a$ and $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector on $n$ coordinates
